build_wav2vec_model: build a Wav2VecModel from Wav2VecConfig to extract audio features using convolutional layers
create_conv_feature_extractor: create a ConvFeatureExtractionModel with configurable conv layers and log compression for audio feature extraction
create_conv_aggregator: create a ConvAggegator with skip connections and residual scaling to aggregate extracted audio features
create_wav2vec_predictions: create a Wav2VecPredictionsModel to compute contrastive CPC logits and targets from aggregated features
review_wav2vec_config: review the Wav2VecConfig dataclass to understand hyperparameters for prediction steps, negatives, and vector quantization
